projects.title: CVisto
projects.description: AI-powered SaaS platform that helps users create LinkedIn-style profiles, analyze job postings with AI, and generate tailored CVs for each application (exportable as DOCX), with application tracking.

projects.title: CIRCULO
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for clothing. Sellers can publish products with images, manage stock and discounts. Buyers can explore the catalog, filter, view details and checkout.

projects.title: Calcu
projects.description: Scientific RPN/RPL calculator with computer algebra system. Command-line calculator inspired by HP-48/HP-50g with reverse polish notation and 560+ built-in operators: symbolic algebra, numerical calculus, statistics, graph theory (80+ operators), automata & formal languages, cryptography, TVM financial functions, physical units, 2D/3D plotting, and RPL programming.

projects.title: BECCAT
projects.description: Educational video game that teaches logic, math and programming to children aged 8-15 through puzzles and a narrative starring cats. Currently in development.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description: Online portfolio with projects and technical blog, responsive and SEO optimized. Built as a single-page application with custom routing and markdown blog system.

projects.title: TATLO
projects.description: Turn All The Lights Off! An infinitely replayable puzzle game with customizable boards and colors.

projects.title: Mubble (Contributor)
projects.description: Minecraft mod with 10,000+ downloads. Contributed features as a member of DawnTeamMC, significantly expanding gameplay.

projects.title: Hybrid Database System
projects.description: Full-stack database project combining PostgreSQL (relational), MongoDB and Apache Cassandra (NoSQL) to store and query FIFA World Cup data. Compared performance and scalability between relational and NoSQL models.

projects.title: Sudoku Solver
projects.description: Comparative analysis of algorithm efficiency and complexity for solving Sudokus using backtracking and branch & bound techniques.

projects.title: Data Structures Project
projects.description: Implementation of abstract data types and balanced tree structures in Java.
